heading: Your next move starts with the money you already own.
standfirst: A one-year investment plan to grow RM13,491, recycle weak positions and buy better opportunities as their evidence improves.

outlook.label: Selective opportunities · elevated risk
outlook.summary: Stocks are rotating away from crowded AI names as Treasuries attract safety buying. That creates bond entry opportunities and a reason to look beyond technology. Oil and sovereign-debt pressures can still reverse the move.
outlook.whatChanges: A new earnings report, policy surprise, yield reversal or valuation change can replace today's recommended candidates. The market view is evidence-led, not frozen by an older research dossier.

capital.riskNote: Entire starting account is risk capital. Targets are not guarantees; the −10% level is a review trigger, not loss protection.

firstMoves.label: FIRST MOVE
firstMoves.title: Review what to sell before buying
firstMoves.description: DAYANG's weakened earnings case is the first exit review. Recheck TSLA and the combined YTL Power/warrant concentration.
firstMoves.do: Confirm Rakuten quantities, cash balance and the warrant's expiry. Prioritise selling investments that no longer offer the best prospective return.
firstMoves.notYet: Historical positions and RM13,491 total NAV do not establish how much free cash is available.

firstMoves.label: BEST FIRST BUY IDEA
firstMoves.title: Start with intermediate US Treasuries
firstMoves.description: Treasury bonds have begun providing protection during technology selling. VGIT takes less long-rate risk than TLT.
firstMoves.do: Prepare RM2,000 initial VGIT exposure, then RM2,047 only if post-Fed yields and USD/MYR still support the case.
firstMoves.notYet: Requires proceeds or verified cash, next-session quote, ETF availability and duration/FX check.

firstMoves.label: KEEP FLEXIBILITY
firstMoves.title: Leave room for better prices
firstMoves.description: RM2,024 remains in MYR and RM1,349 is earmarked for SGOV if broker access, taxes and FX make sense.
firstMoves.do: Don't deploy idle cash because the market is moving. Use it when another investment has passed the earnings and price tests.
firstMoves.notYet: SGOV is a USD T-bill ETF, not MYR cash or a guaranteed 5% deposit.

opportunities.name: Intermediate US Treasury ETF
opportunities.case: Income plus moderate potential price gains if US yields keep falling.
opportunities.buyWhen: After checking the next executable price, Treasury real yields and USD/MYR. Second tranche after the 27–28 October Fed meeting if the bond thesis survives.
opportunities.sellWhen: Review after a substantial yield decline or if real yields and term premium begin rising persistently.
opportunities.risk: Currency movements and duration losses; not principal-guaranteed.

opportunities.name: 0–3 Month Treasury ETF
opportunities.case: Keep USD capital relatively liquid while waiting for higher-return entries.
opportunities.buyWhen: Confirm Rakuten eligibility, FX charges and tax treatment against simply keeping MYR cash.
opportunities.sellWhen: Redeploy only when a better idea meets the full investment test.
opportunities.risk: USD/MYR and distribution mechanics; not a MYR bank deposit.
opportunities.nextEvent: Next broker price and fee check

opportunities.name: Equal-weight S&P 500 ETF
opportunities.case: Less dependence on a handful of mega-cap AI names; equal-weight stocks held up better during the technology sell-off.
opportunities.buyWhen: Fresh price and earnings breadth confirm the rotation, without paying an inflated short-term premium.
opportunities.sellWhen: Trim when broad earnings deteriorate or the position no longer beats cash and Treasuries on expected return.
opportunities.risk: Still equity downside; equal-weighting increases exposure to economically sensitive businesses.
opportunities.nextEvent: Q3 reporting and next broad market session

opportunities.name: CF Industries
opportunities.case: Substantial reported cash flow and potentially favourable nitrogen supply economics offer a non-AI return driver.
opportunities.buyWhen: Read 4 November Q3 results, remove one-off profit items, and confirm fertiliser pricing exceeds natural-gas cost pressure.
opportunities.sellWhen: Review if the nitrogen/gas margin advantage reverses or the cash economics deteriorate.
opportunities.risk: Agricultural cycle, energy feedstock cost and expensive entry after strong earnings.

opportunities.name: 20+ Year Treasury ETF
opportunities.case: Meaningful upside if long-term yields fall further during a credit or growth scare.
opportunities.buyWhen: Check the 20/30-year yield curve and inflation response after FOMC. Never add solely because bonds rose yesterday.
opportunities.sellWhen: Review partial profit after roughly 12–15% price appreciation or if a 50bp adverse yield reversal invalidates the thesis.
opportunities.risk: Roughly 14.8-year duration: a +0.50 percentage-point yield move can cause about a 7.4% price decline before income/convexity.

opportunities.name: Taiwan Semiconductor (ADR)
opportunities.case: Exceptional actual Q3 revenue and margins, but semiconductor valuations and AI credit concerns remain exposed.
opportunities.buyWhen: Funded chip demand remains solid and sector breadth/valuation stabilise. Need a post-sell-off entry price, not an automatic dip buy.
opportunities.sellWhen: Reduce if advanced-node cash generation, bookings or balance-sheet outlook break.
opportunities.risk: Sector crowding, geopolitics and high valuation sensitivity.
opportunities.nextEvent: Next operating update and sector confirmation

marketSignals.name: Treasuries
marketSignals.body: 10-year US yields briefly fell below 5% as investors sought safety. Important for VGIT and TLT. Do not assume inflation has ended.

marketSignals.name: Equity rotation
marketSignals.body: The technology-heavy Nasdaq fell sharply while the equal-weight S&P held up. Stock selection matters more than index direction.

marketSignals.body: French government debt, Japanese funding flows, UK fiscal risk and Australian/NZ policy are reasons to compare foreign bonds carefully after MYR FX.

integrity.sourceTimestampNote: Model prepared 23 October 2026 from 21–22 October last-completed-session data; no intraday broker prices. Research changes on subsequent manual PS refreshes.
integrity.ownership: Power Stack owns decisions; Live Desk and Bluebelly supply contextual evidence, never a mandatory buy/sell gate.
integrity.instructions: Client-facing recommendation view. No auto-placement or auto-funded purchases. Replace data when newer corroborated evidence arrives.

researchRadar.name: Ecovyst
researchRadar.case: Acid production/regeneration with sulphur cost pass-through; upside must come from real margin and volume, not sales inflation.
researchRadar.buyWhen: Verify 5 Nov Q3 results, acquisition-adjusted cash flow, debt bridge, current enterprise value and broker availability. Indicative EV/2026 adjusted EBITDA ~7.4–7.8× using third-party EV; not an entry signal.
researchRadar.sellWhen: Reject thesis if volumes, net pricing or free cash flow disappoint or leverage rises.
researchRadar.risk: Sulphur input pass-through is not itself profit; acquisition and cyclical chemical demand risks.

researchRadar.name: Ivanhoe Mines
researchRadar.case: Kamoa-Kakula smelting produces sulphuric acid by-product; Q3 output 118,638 tonnes at ~$900/t realised acid price.
researchRadar.buyWhen: Review 3 Nov results, attributable acid sales/profit, copper operating costs, country risk and current valuation; verify broker listing access.
researchRadar.sellWhen: Reject if acid revenue is immaterial to enterprise value or copper execution risk overwhelms it.
researchRadar.risk: Copper/DRC exposure dominates; produced acid tonnes are not sold tonnes or profit.

researchRadar.name: Mosaic
researchRadar.case: Expensive sulphur pressures phosphate margins; potential recovery only after input costs and production improve.
researchRadar.buyWhen: Verify lower delivered sulphur costs, sustained phosphate prices, plant operating rates and valuation.
researchRadar.sellWhen: Reject if sulphur costs persist or phosphate selling prices weaken faster.
researchRadar.risk: Shortage can harm producer economics rather than help.

researchRadar.name: Valero Energy
researchRadar.case: Diesel crack spreads and refinery throughput are more direct drivers than crude price alone.
researchRadar.buyWhen: Verify regional distillate cracks, utilisation, forward earnings, valuation and existing energy exposure.
researchRadar.sellWhen: Reject if diesel cracks compress or refinery cost inflation overwhelms margins.
researchRadar.risk: Existing XOM/MISC/HIBISCS/DAYANG exposure may duplicate energy risk.
